plotpath<- topDir 

source(paste0(rpath,"proj_functions.R")) # project coordinates between lat lon and projected coordinates (meters or km)
source(paste0(rpath,"image_scale.R")) # add a color scale to a plot
load(paste0(rpath,"erie05lcc_grid_polys.Rdata"))
load(paste0(rpath,"erie05lcc_grid_coords.Rdata"))
coordsn$X <- coordsn$X/1000
coordsn$Y <- coordsn$Y/1000
coordse$X <- coordse$X/1000
coordse$Y <- coordse$Y/1000

##############################################
# load info for FVCOM temperature, currents
###############################################
fvcomDir <- paste0(topDir,"august/")

#4-20-26 downloaded leofs output from
#https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/data/operational-nowcast-and-forecast-hydrodynamic-model-systems-co-ops/access/lake-erie-operational-forecast-system-leofs/2024/08/


mifns <- Sys.glob(paste0(fvcomDir,"nos.leofs*.nc"))
nfiles <- length(mifns)
xlimLL <- c(-83.47336, -78.8) 
ylimLL <- c(41.36373, 43) 
lims <- projLcc(data.frame(lon=xlimLL, lat=ylimLL) , prj_new)
xlim <- lims$X
ylim <- lims$Y

plotPolys(shoreline)
plotPolys(shoreline, xlim=xlim, ylim=ylim, projection = TRUE)

nutNames <- c("temp", "u", "v")
nutLabs <- list( 
  expression(paste("Temperature, ",degree,"C"))
  ,expression(paste("u velocity, ",m,"/s"))
  ,expression(paste("v velocity, ",m,"/s"))
)
getFVCOM <- function(xlim, ylim, periods, year){
  # plotPolys(shorelineLL, xlim=xlimLL, ylim=ylimLL)
  # plotPolys(shoreline, xlim=xlim, ylim=ylim, projection=TRUE)
  
  print(paste(xlim,ylim))
  
  ro1 <-  which(coordsn$X > min(xlim)-2 & coordsn$X < max(xlim)+2 & coordsn$Y > min(ylim)-2 & coordsn$Y < max(ylim)+2)
  nodes <- coordsn$node[ro1]
  bbnodes <- coordsn[ro1,]
  nnodes <- length(nodes)
  
  # # find the element closest to each node for getting the velocities
  bbeles <- c()
  bbeles1 <- coordse[which(coordse$X <= max(xlim)+2 & coordse$X >= min(xlim)-2 & coordse$Y <= max(ylim)+2 & coordse$Y >= min(ylim)-2),]
  for(i in 1:nrow(bbnodes)){
    dist <- sqrt((bbeles1$X - bbnodes$X[i])^2 + (bbeles1$Y - bbnodes$Y[i] )^2)
    xx2 <- which(dist==min(dist))[1]
    bbeles <- c(bbeles,bbeles1$node[xx2])
  }
  
  nutis <- 1:length(nutNames)
  nutDims <- rep(3,length(nutNames))
  scales <- rep(1,length(nutNames))
  
  plist <- list()
  pei=1

    length_periods <- length(periods)

  for(pei in 1:length(periods)){

      fileNos <- 1:nfiles

 
    # get the model values
    first <- 1
    #loop through the files
    fileNo <- 1
    # for(fileNo in 1:nfiles){
    for(fileNo in fileNos){
      
      fn1 <- mifns[fileNo]

      if(file.exists(fn1)){
        nc <- nc_open(fn1, readunlim=F)
        print(paste("file opened",fn1))
      }else{
        print(paste("file not found",fn1))
        break
      }
      
      time2 <- ncvar_get(nc, "Times", start=c(1,1), count=c(-1,-1))
      time2 <- as.POSIXct(time2, format="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S", tz="UTC")
      ntime <- length(time2)
      
      if(ntime>0){
        if(first==1){
          time1 <- as.POSIXct(time2, tz="UTC")
          # # find the record corresponding to the hour of the transect
          # timi <- which(time1 == date1)
          
          siglay <- ncvar_get(nc, "siglay", start=c(1,1), count=c(1,-1))
          siglev <- ncvar_get(nc, "siglev", start=c(1,1), count=c(1,-1))
          nlay <- 1 # length(siglay)
          h <- ncvar_get(nc, "h", start=c(1), count=c(-1))
          
        }else{
          #  time1 <- c(time1, time2)
          time1 <- rbind(data.frame(x=time1),data.frame(x=time2))[[1]]
        }
        
        #      timeNos <- seq(1,ntime,stride)

          timeNos <- which(time2 >= dateRange[1] & time2 <= dateRange[2])
        if(length(timeNos) < 1 ){
          print("time out of dateRange")
          next
          } # go to next file

        ntime2 <- length(timeNos)
        if(first == 1){
          plotTimes <- time2[timeNos]
        }else{
          #plotTimes <- c(plotTimes, time2[timeNos])
          plotTimes <- rbind(data.frame(x=plotTimes),data.frame(x=time2[timeNos]))[[1]]
        }
        
        # set up empty arrays to hold the data from this nc file
        list1 <- list()
        nuti <- 1
        for(nuti in 1:length(nutis)){
          nutNo <- nutis[nuti]
          nutName <- nutNames[nutNo]
          nutDim <- nutDims[nutNo]
          if(nutDim ==3){
            array1 <- array(NA, dim=c(nnodes, nlay , ntime2))
          }else{
            array1 <- array(NA, dim=c(nnodes, 1, ntime2))
          }
          list1[[nuti]] <- array1
        } # end nuti, set up arrays
        
        nuti <- 1
        for(nuti in 1:length(nutis)){
          nutNo <- nutis[nuti]
          nutName <- nutNames[nutNo]
          
          #  print(paste("fileNo=",fileNo,nutName,"nnodes=",nnodes))
          
          timi <- 1
          for(timi in 1:ntime2){
            timeNo <- timeNos[timi]
            #  print(paste("fileNo= ",fileNo,time2[timeNo]))
            
            nodei = 1
            #for(nodei in 1:length(nodes)){
            m <- nodes[nodei]
            nutDim <- nutDims[nutNo]
            if(nutDim ==3){
              if(nutName == "Chl"){
                # values1 <- ncvar_get(nc, "THETACHL1", start=c(1,1,timeNo), count=c(-1,1,1))[nodes]
                # values2 <- ncvar_get(nc, "Phytoplankton", start=c(1,1,timeNo), count=c(-1,1,1))[nodes]
                # values <- values1*values2
              }else if(nutName %in% c("u","v")){
                n <- bbeles[nodei]
                # values <- ncvar_get(nc, nutName, start=c(1,1,1), count=c(-1,-1,-1))[bbeles,,]  
                values <- ncvar_get(nc, nutName, start=c(1,1,timi), count=c(-1,1,1))[bbeles]  # surface only
                #values <- apply(values, MARGIN=c(1), FUN=mean)
              }else if(nutName =="btemp"){
                # values <- ncvar_get(nc, nutName, start=c(1,1,1), count=c(-1,-1,-1))[nodes,,]
                values <- ncvar_get(nc, "temp", start=c(1,20,timi), count=c(-1,1,1))[nodes] # bottom only
                #values <- apply(values, MARGIN=c(1), FUN=mean)
              }else{
                # values <- ncvar_get(nc, nutName, start=c(1,1,1), count=c(-1,-1,-1))[nodes,,]
                values <- ncvar_get(nc, nutName, start=c(1,1,timi), count=c(-1,1,1))[nodes] # surface only
                #values <- apply(values, MARGIN=c(1), FUN=mean)
              }
              dim2 <- nlay
            }else{
              # values <- ncvar_get(nc, nutName, start=c(1,timeNo), count=c(-1,1))[nodes]
              # dim2 <- 1
            }
            array1 <- list1[[nuti]]
            # array1[nodei,,timi] <- values
            array1[,,timi] <- values
            list1[[nuti]] <- array1
            
            #  } #end nodei
          } # end timi
        } # end nuti
        
        # paste together the arrays from the time block in each ncdf file
        if(first==1){
          first <- 0
          list2 <- list1
        }else{
          for(nuti in 1:length(nutis)){
            nutNo <- nutis[nuti]
            nutDim <- nutDims[nutNo]
            if(nutDim ==3){
              dim2 <- nlay
            }else{
              dim2 <- 1
            }
            array2 <- list2[[nuti]]
            dim32 <- dim(array2)[3]
            array1 <- list1[[nuti]]
            dim31 <- dim(array1)[3]
            array3 <- array(NA, dim=c(nnodes, dim2, dim32+dim31))
            array3[,,1:dim32] <- array2
            ind1 <- dim32+1
            ind2 <- dim32+dim31
            array3[,,ind1:ind2] <- array1
            list2[[nuti]] <- array3
            rm(array3)
          } # end nuti
          
        } #if(fileNo==1){
        
      } # end if ntime>1
      #nc_close( nc )
    } # end fileNo loop
    
    plist[[pei]] <- list(list2=list2, time1=time1, plotTimes=plotTimes, nodes=nodes)
    return(plist)
    
  } # end pei
  
}

getInterp <- function(values, plotres=0.5, xlim, ylim){
  require(akima)
  #plotres <- 0.5 #  0.02 # 0.05 # 0.2 resolution of interpolation grid, km
  xlength <- (xlim[2]-xlim[1])/plotres
  ylength <- (ylim[2]-ylim[1])/plotres
  xx <- nodes # 1:nrow(coordsn) #which(coordsn$X <= xlim[2] & coordsn$X >= xlim[1] & coordsn$Y <= ylim[2] & coordsn$Y >= ylim[1])
  x=coordsn$X[xx]
  y=coordsn$Y[xx]
  z=values #values[xx]
  data.interp <- interp(x,y,z, duplicate="mean"
                        ,xo=seq(min(x), max(x), length = xlength)
                        ,yo=seq(min(y), max(y), length = ylength)
                        , extrap=FALSE
                        , linear=TRUE
  )
  return(data.interp)
}



## loop through the three periods to plot  ###########################
nutNames <- c("temp", "u", "v")
ploti = 1 

# loop could be modified to plot multiple time periods
for(ploti in 1:1){
  
  # CJFAS figure dimensions
  #Supply figures sized for publication: 1-column width is 8.84 cm, 2-column is 18.2 cm with a max. height of 23.7 cm and a resolution of 300 dpi
  par(def.par)
  if(ploti==1){
    fn1 <- paste0(plotpath, "august_pre.pdf")
  }


  width=18.2/2.54
  pdf(file=fn1, width=width, height=width*0.85, pointsize=10)
  
  n<-layout(matrix(c(1,2), 1, 2, byrow = TRUE), widths=c(1,0.25))
  #layout.show(n)
  
  if(ploti==1){
    #August 2-9
    dateRange <- c(as.POSIXct("2024-08-02 01:00:00 UTC", tz="UTC"),  as.POSIXct("2024-08-08 23:00:00 UTC", tz="UTC")) 
    
  }
  

  # adjust map area within plot area
  pltMap2 <- c(0.1,0.98,0.08,0.99)
  
  # get FVCOM data
   periods <- list(
     seq(as.numeric(format(dateRange[1], "%j")),as.numeric(format(dateRange[2], "%j")))
   )
   plist <- getFVCOM(xlim=xlim, ylim=ylim, periods=periods, year=format(dateRange[1], "%Y"))

  list2 <- plist[[1]]$list2
  nodes <- plist[[1]]$nodes
  

  # map view of currents and temperature
  plotPolys(shoreline, col="white", border="black", lwd=0.5, projection=TRUE   #col="lightblue"
            ,plt=pltMap2
            ,xlab="Easting, km", ylab="Northing, km", cex.axis=1.0, cex.lab=1.0, tck=-0.014
            ,xlim=xlim ,ylim=ylim
  )

  range(plist[[1]]$plotTimes)
  
  # interpolate model data
  temp1 <- list2[[which(nutNames=="temp")]] # model data to plot
  values <- apply(temp1, MARGIN=c(1), FUN=mean)
  plotres=0.5
  data.interp <- getInterp(values, plotres=plotres, xlim=xlim, ylim=ylim)
  
  colorbarlab <- nutLabs[[1]]
  
  # set colors and breaks for color bar, and make image plots
  nlevel <- 256
  colorbar <- tim.colors(nlevel) # tim.colors(256)
  zlim <- c(10,30 )
  
  cols <- colorbar
  graphics::image(data.interp, zlim=zlim, col=cols, add=TRUE
                  # , xaxt="n"
                  , yaxt="n"
                  ,ylim=ylim
                  ,xlim=xlim
                  ,xlab=""
  )
  
  # plot image again, slightly shifted, to eliminate aliasing artifacts in image rendering
  data.interp2 <- data.interp
  data.interp2$y <- data.interp$y + plotres/2
  data.interp2$x <- data.interp$x + plotres/2
  graphics::image(data.interp2, zlim=zlim, col=cols, add=TRUE
                  # , xaxt="n"
                  , yaxt="n"
                  ,ylim=ylim
                  ,xlim=xlim
                  ,xlab=""
  )
  
  #contour(data.interp, add=TRUE, levels=seq(2,30,2))
  #  contour(data.interp, add=TRUE, levels=c(seq(0,6),seq(8,30,2)))
  
  addPolys(mask2, col="tan", border="black")
  #legend("topleft",legend="b",bty="n")
  
  uscale <- abs(xlim[2]-xlim[1])/3.5 # scale so that uprime arrow is 1/10 of x axis range for 1 m/s velocity

  # interpolate velocities to regular grid
  # use a small value of plotres, then sample from the results with skip
  # to get arrows right up to the shoreline
  plotresv=0.5
  u <- list2[[which(nutNames=="u")]][,1, ]
  values <- apply(u, MARGIN=c(1), FUN=mean)
  ui <- getInterp(values, plotres=plotresv, xlim=xlim, ylim=ylim)
  v <- list2[[which(nutNames=="v")]][,1, ]
  values <- apply(v, MARGIN=c(1), FUN=mean)
  vi <- getInterp(values, plotres=plotresv, xlim=xlim, ylim=ylim)
  
  x0 <- c() # ui$x
  y0 <- c() # ui$y
  x1 <- c()
  y1 <- c()
  # rearrange into vectors for arrows()
  skip=4
  # current vectors will be plotted along north-south or east-west lines
  # change "skip" to modify spacing along the lines
  # multiply "skip" by a factor in i or j to modify spacing between lines
  # or make lines go north-south or east-west
  for(i in seq(1,length(ui$x),by=skip*5)){
    for(j in seq(1,length(ui$y),by=skip)){
      x0 <- c(x0, ui$x[i])
      y0 <- c(y0, ui$y[j])
      x1 <- c(x1, ui$z[i,j]*uscale)
      y1 <- c(y1, vi$z[i,j]*uscale)
    }
  }
  # select locations within the shoreline
  events <- data.frame(EID=1:length(x0), X=x0, Y=y0)
  fp <- findPolys (events=events, polys=shoreline )
  arrows(x0=x0[fp$EID], y0=y0[fp$EID], x1=x0[fp$EID]+x1[fp$EID], y1=y0[fp$EID]+y1[fp$EID], length = 0.03, angle = 30, col="black")
  
 
  # plot a scale arrow for velocity arrows
  x0 <- grconvertX(0.85, from="npc")
  y0 <- grconvertY(0.07, from="npc")
  arrows(x0=x0, y0=y0, x1=x0+0.05*uscale, y1=y0, length = 0.03, angle = 30)
  y0 <- grconvertY(0.05, from="npc")
  text(x0-10, y0, expression(paste("0.125 ",m," ",s^{-1})), pos=4)

  # box(which="plot", col="red")
  # box(which="figure", col="orange")
  # box(which="inner", col="yellow")
  # box(which="outer", col="blue")
  
  x0 <- grconvertX(0.1, from="npc")
  y0 <- grconvertY(0.90, from="npc")
  text(x0, y0, paste(dateRange, collapse = " - "), pos=4)
  
  # plot the scale bar 
  par(mar=c(8, 2.1, 5, 3.2) )
  image.scale(zlim=zlim, col=colorbar, axis.pos=4)
  mtext(colorbarlab,side=2,line=0.3, cex=0.7)
  
  par(def.par)
  graphics.off()
  
  }# end ploti
  #############################

                values <- ncvar_get(nc, "temp", start=c(1,20,timi), count=c(-1,1,1))[nodes] # bottom only
                #values <- apply(values, MARGIN=c(1), FUN=mean)
              }else{
                # values <- ncvar_get(nc, nutName, start=c(1,1,1), count=c(-1,-1,-1))[nodes,,]
                values <- ncvar_get(nc, nutName, start=c(1,1,timi), count=c(-1,1,1))[nodes] # surface only
                #values <- apply(values, MARGIN=c(1), FUN=mean)
              }
              dim2 <- nlay
            }else{
              # values <- ncvar_get(nc, nutName, start=c(1,timeNo), count=c(-1,1))[nodes]
              # dim2 <- 1
            }
            array1 <- list1[[nuti]]
            # array1[nodei,,timi] <- values
            array1[,,timi] <- values
            list1[[nuti]] <- array1
            
            #  } #end nodei
          } # end timi
        } # end nuti
        
        # paste together the arrays from the time block in each ncdf file
        if(first==1){
          first <- 0
          list2 <- list1
        }else{
          for(nuti in 1:length(nutis)){
            nutNo <- nutis[nuti]
            nutDim <- nutDims[nutNo]
            if(nutDim ==3){
              dim2 <- nlay
            }else{
              dim2 <- 1
            }
            array2 <- list2[[nuti]]
            dim32 <- dim(array2)[3]
            array1 <- list1[[nuti]]
            dim31 <- dim(array1)[3]
            array3 <- array(NA, dim=c(nnodes, dim2, dim32+dim31))
            array3[,,1:dim32] <- array2
            ind1 <- dim32+1
            ind2 <- dim32+dim31
            array3[,,ind1:ind2] <- array1
            list2[[nuti]] <- array3
            rm(array3)
          } # end nuti
          
        } #if(fileNo==1){
        
      } # end if ntime>1
      #nc_close( nc )
    } # end fileNo loop
    
    plist[[pei]] <- list(list2=list2, time1=time1, plotTimes=plotTimes, nodes=nodes)
    return(plist)
    
  } # end pei
  
}

getInterp <- function(values, plotres=0.5, xlim, ylim){
  require(akima)
  #plotres <- 0.5 #  0.02 # 0.05 # 0.2 resolution of interpolation grid, km
  xlength <- (xlim[2]-xlim[1])/plotres
  ylength <- (ylim[2]-ylim[1])/plotres
  xx <- nodes # 1:nrow(coordsn) #which(coordsn$X <= xlim[2] & coordsn$X >= xlim[1] & coordsn$Y <= ylim[2] & coordsn$Y >= ylim[1])
  x=coordsn$X[xx]
  y=coordsn$Y[xx]
  z=values #values[xx]
  data.interp <- interp(x,y,z, duplicate="mean"
                        ,xo=seq(min(x), max(x), length = xlength)
                        ,yo=seq(min(y), max(y), length = ylength)
                        , extrap=FALSE
                        , linear=TRUE
  )
  return(data.interp)
}

# loop could be modified to plot multiple time periods

            ,plt=pltMap2
            ,xlab="Easting, km", ylab="Northing, km", cex.axis=1.0, cex.lab=1.0, tck=-0.014
            ,xlim=xlim ,ylim=ylim
  )

  range(plist[[1]]$plotTimes)
  
  # interpolate model data
  temp1 <- list2[[which(nutNames=="temp")]] # model data to plot
  values <- apply(temp1, MARGIN=c(1), FUN=mean)
  plotres=0.5
  data.interp <- getInterp(values, plotres=plotres, xlim=xlim, ylim=ylim)
  
  colorbarlab <- nutLabs[[1]]
  
  # set colors and breaks for color bar, and make image plots
  nlevel <- 256
  colorbar <- tim.colors(nlevel) # tim.colors(256)
  zlim <- c(10,30 )
  
  cols <- colorbar
  graphics::image(data.interp, zlim=zlim, col=cols, add=TRUE
                  # , xaxt="n"
                  , yaxt="n"
                  ,ylim=ylim
                  ,xlim=xlim
                  ,xlab=""
  )
  
  # plot image again, slightly shifted, to eliminate aliasing artifacts in image rendering
  data.interp2 <- data.interp
  data.interp2$y <- data.interp$y + plotres/2
  data.interp2$x <- data.interp$x + plotres/2
  graphics::image(data.interp2, zlim=zlim, col=cols, add=TRUE
                  # , xaxt="n"
                  , yaxt="n"
                  ,ylim=ylim
                  ,xlim=xlim
                  ,xlab=""
  )
  
  #contour(data.interp, add=TRUE, levels=seq(2,30,2))
  #  contour(data.interp, add=TRUE, levels=c(seq(0,6),seq(8,30,2)))
  
  addPolys(mask2, col="tan", border="black")
  #legend("topleft",legend="b",bty="n")
  
  uscale <- abs(xlim[2]-xlim[1])/3.5 # scale so that uprime arrow is 1/10 of x axis range for 1 m/s velocity

  # interpolate velocities to regular grid
  # use a small value of plotres, then sample from the results with skip
  # to get arrows right up to the shoreline
  plotresv=0.5
  u <- list2[[which(nutNames=="u")]][,1, ]
  values <- apply(u, MARGIN=c(1), FUN=mean)
  ui <- getInterp(values, plotres=plotresv, xlim=xlim, ylim=ylim)
  v <- list2[[which(nutNames=="v")]][,1, ]
  values <- apply(v, MARGIN=c(1), FUN=mean)
  vi <- getInterp(values, plotres=plotresv, xlim=xlim, ylim=ylim)
  
  x0 <- c() # ui$x
  y0 <- c() # ui$y
  x1 <- c()
  y1 <- c()
  # rearrange into vectors for arrows()
  skip=4
  # current vectors will be plotted along north-south or east-west lines
  # change "skip" to modify spacing along the lines
  # multiply "skip" by a factor in i or j to modify spacing between lines
  # or make lines go north-south or east-west
  for(i in seq(1,length(ui$x),by=skip*5)){
    for(j in seq(1,length(ui$y),by=skip)){
      x0 <- c(x0, ui$x[i])
      y0 <- c(y0, ui$y[j])
      x1 <- c(x1, ui$z[i,j]*uscale)
      y1 <- c(y1, vi$z[i,j]*uscale)
    }
  }
  # select locations within the shoreline
  events <- data.frame(EID=1:length(x0), X=x0, Y=y0)
  fp <- findPolys (events=events, polys=shoreline )
  arrows(x0=x0[fp$EID], y0=y0[fp$EID], x1=x0[fp$EID]+x1[fp$EID], y1=y0[fp$EID]+y1[fp$EID], length = 0.03, angle = 30, col="black")
  
 
  # plot a scale arrow for velocity arrows
  x0 <- grconvertX(0.85, from="npc")
  y0 <- grconvertY(0.07, from="npc")
  arrows(x0=x0, y0=y0, x1=x0+0.05*uscale, y1=y0, length = 0.03, angle = 30)
  y0 <- grconvertY(0.05, from="npc")
  text(x0-10, y0, expression(paste("0.125 ",m," ",s^{-1})), pos=4)

  # box(which="plot", col="red")
  # box(which="figure", col="orange")
  # box(which="inner", col="yellow")
  # box(which="outer", col="blue")
  
  x0 <- grconvertX(0.1, from="npc")
  y0 <- grconvertY(0.90, from="npc")
  text(x0, y0, paste(dateRange, collapse = " - "), pos=4)
  
  # plot the scale bar 
  par(mar=c(8, 2.1, 5, 3.2) )
  image.scale(zlim=zlim, col=colorbar, axis.pos=4)
  mtext(colorbarlab,side=2,line=0.3, cex=0.7)
  
  par(def.par)
  graphics.off()
  
  }# end ploti
  #############################

getInterp <- function(values, plotres=0.5, xlim, ylim){
  require(akima)
  #plotres <- 0.5 #  0.02 # 0.05 # 0.2 resolution of interpolation grid, km
  xlength <- (xlim[2]-xlim[1])/plotres
  ylength <- (ylim[2]-ylim[1])/plotres
  xx <- nodes # 1:nrow(coordsn) #which(coordsn$X <= xlim[2] & coordsn$X >= xlim[1] & coordsn$Y <= ylim[2] & coordsn$Y >= ylim[1])
  x=coordsn$X[xx]
  y=coordsn$Y[xx]
  z=values #values[xx]
  data.interp <- interp(x,y,z, duplicate="mean"
                        ,xo=seq(min(x), max(x), length = xlength)
                        ,yo=seq(min(y), max(y), length = ylength)
                        , extrap=FALSE
                        , linear=TRUE
  )
  return(data.interp)
}

      y0 <- c(y0, ui$y[j])
      x1 <- c(x1, ui$z[i,j]*uscale)
      y1 <- c(y1, vi$z[i,j]*uscale)
    }
  }
  # select locations within the shoreline
  events <- data.frame(EID=1:length(x0), X=x0, Y=y0)
  fp <- findPolys (events=events, polys=shoreline )
  arrows(x0=x0[fp$EID], y0=y0[fp$EID], x1=x0[fp$EID]+x1[fp$EID], y1=y0[fp$EID]+y1[fp$EID], length = 0.03, angle = 30, col="black")
  
 
  # plot a scale arrow for velocity arrows
  x0 <- grconvertX(0.85, from="npc")
  y0 <- grconvertY(0.07, from="npc")
  arrows(x0=x0, y0=y0, x1=x0+0.05*uscale, y1=y0, length = 0.03, angle = 30)
  y0 <- grconvertY(0.05, from="npc")
  text(x0-10, y0, expression(paste("0.125 ",m," ",s^{-1})), pos=4)

  # box(which="plot", col="red")
  # box(which="figure", col="orange")
  # box(which="inner", col="yellow")
  # box(which="outer", col="blue")
  
  x0 <- grconvertX(0.1, from="npc")
  y0 <- grconvertY(0.90, from="npc")
  text(x0, y0, paste(dateRange, collapse = " - "), pos=4)
  
  # plot the scale bar 
  par(mar=c(8, 2.1, 5, 3.2) )
  image.scale(zlim=zlim, col=colorbar, axis.pos=4)
  mtext(colorbarlab,side=2,line=0.3, cex=0.7)
  
  par(def.par)
  graphics.off()
  
  }# end ploti
  #############################

getInterp <- function(values, plotres=0.5, xlim, ylim){
  require(akima)
  #plotres <- 0.5 #  0.02 # 0.05 # 0.2 resolution of interpolation grid, km
  xlength <- (xlim[2]-xlim[1])/plotres
  ylength <- (ylim[2]-ylim[1])/plotres
  xx <- nodes # 1:nrow(coordsn) #which(coordsn$X <= xlim[2] & coordsn$X >= xlim[1] & coordsn$Y <= ylim[2] & coordsn$Y >= ylim[1])
  x=coordsn$X[xx]
  y=coordsn$Y[xx]
  z=values #values[xx]
  data.interp <- interp(x,y,z, duplicate="mean"
                        ,xo=seq(min(x), max(x), length = xlength)
                        ,yo=seq(min(y), max(y), length = ylength)
                        , extrap=FALSE
                        , linear=TRUE
  )
  return(data.interp)
}

                  , yaxt="n"

                  ,xlim=xlim

  )
  
  # plot image again, slightly shifted, to eliminate aliasing artifacts in image rendering

  # to get arrows right up to the shoreline
  plotresv=0.5
  u <- list2[[which(nutNames=="u")]][,1, ]

  skip=4

  # multiply "skip" by a factor in i or j to modify spacing between lines
  # or make lines go north-south or east-west
  for(i in seq(1,length(ui$x),by=skip*5)){
    for(j in seq(1,length(ui$y),by=skip)){

      y0 <- c(y0, ui$y[j])
      x1 <- c(x1, ui$z[i,j]*uscale)

    }
  }

  fp <- findPolys (events=events, polys=shoreline )
  arrows(x0=x0[fp$EID], y0=y0[fp$EID], x1=x0[fp$EID]+x1[fp$EID], y1=y0[fp$EID]+y1[fp$EID], length = 0.03, angle = 30, col="black")
  
 
  # plot a scale arrow for velocity arrows

  y0 <- grconvertY(0.05, from="npc")
  text(x0-10, y0, expression(paste("0.125 ",m," ",s^{-1})), pos=4)

  # box(which="plot", col="red")

  x0 <- grconvertX(0.1, from="npc")
  y0 <- grconvertY(0.90, from="npc")
  text(x0, y0, paste(dateRange, collapse = " - "), pos=4)
  
  # plot the scale bar 
  par(mar=c(8, 2.1, 5, 3.2) )
  image.scale(zlim=zlim, col=colorbar, axis.pos=4)
  mtext(colorbarlab,side=2,line=0.3, cex=0.7)
  
  par(def.par)
  graphics.off()
  
  }# end ploti
